AISA President Neha Bora Credits Anti-CAA Protests for Activism

Neha Bora, the national president of the All India Students’ Association (AISA), has stated that the anti-Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) protests of 2019-2020 were instrumental in shaping her political journey and activism. Bora, described as a 29-year-old Gen Z activist and theatre actress, has brought renewed attention to the ideological debates surrounding the movement, citizenship rights, and student activism.
